describe.description: The creature is a quadrupedal, bear-like mammal shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background. Its body is covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is lighter cream on the chest and belly and darker on the legs and back. Integrated into the fur are multiple glossy, dark brown to black, hard chitinous structures resembling beetle exoskeleton, including a large curved horn on the forehead, a large plate on the shoulder/neck, and several ridged, wing-cover-like plates on the back and sides. The animal stands on four thick legs ending in clawed paws and has a small furry tail at the rear. No wings, tentacles, or additional limbs are visible.

describe.description: A large quadrupedal creature standing in side profile facing right, with the overall shape and fur of a brown bear but with glossy beetle-like armor fused into its body. Dense long shaggy brown fur covers the body, darker brown on the back and legs and pale creamy tan on the chest and belly. The head is bear-like with a long tan muzzle, black nose, dark eyes, and two small rounded furry ears. A single long glossy black curved horn with side notches and a forked tip rises from the top of the forehead. Dark reddish-brown to black shiny exoskeleton plates are embedded in the fur across the back, flank, shoulder hump, throat, and around the leg joints and ankles, including large ridged wing-case-like panels on the mid-side. Small dark oval holes are visible in the fur beside some plates. It stands on four thick furry legs ending in broad clawed paws, with a short furry stub tail at the rear.
